d: An anthropomorphic canine creature with a mature, cunning expression and a lean build. The fur is a mix of warm tan on the muzzle and chest, transitioning to a deep russet brown on the head and body. The eyes are a sharp, golden-yellow with a focused, narrowed gaze. The outfit consists of a dark brown high-collared cloak, a leather chest harness with a small buckle, and off-white trousers tucked into dark brown boots. Visible accessories include a large, heavy-duty crossbow held in the arms and a small glass vial containing a glowing teal liquid. BODY COLOR: Russet brown and tan LEGS: Plantigrade, wearing dark brown boots
